text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I am ready... but
what time was our ride scheduled to arrive?
choice_data_list: 17時ですので、まだ1時間近くございます

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, an appearance at a formal party awaited.
It was a prestigious social gathering attended by
illustrious Umamusume families and high-profile figures.
choice_data_list: 出発前にお夕食を召し上がってしまっては？

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... So that we may focus on socializing,
let us finish our meal beforehand.
choice_data_list: では、カフェテリアへ参りましょう

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing a light meal at the cafeteria, we were having some tea while waiting for the pickup car to arrive, when...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby in her formal attire catches my eye.
She was supposed to be a guest at the party as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ruby, my deepest apologies. It appears
we are hopelessly trapped in traffic...
I am not certain our ride will arrive in time...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Then as expected, let us call a taxi.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Allow me to escort you, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No.
I could not possibly impose upon you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We are headed for the same destination anyway,
so pay it no mind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Lest your beautiful attire be ruined...
please leave this matter to me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. We are upgrading the pickup vehicle to a limousine.
Furthermore, gather everything she requires
without delay.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Makeup kit, slippers for the car,
something to drape over my shoulders, and...
just in case, a spare gown as well.
choice_data_list: すぐに、手配して参ります

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruby. Pray, grant me the honor
of escorting you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Your hand.

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
Presenting Lady Rose Kingdom
and Lady Daiichi Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendees
text_block_list.text:
“My, the two of them are together today...!”
“Come to think of it, they were classmates, weren't they?”
“What a magnificent presence they carry—”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Everyone seems utterly captivated by your beauty.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe it is you who is drawing everyone's attention, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —It appears the dance has begun.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruby.
Would you dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: With pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendees
text_block_list.text:
“Oh, my...”
“How utterly breathtaking...”
“What remarkably dignified poise and grace...”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Truly a magnificent step, Ruby.
Splendid work.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I would say your lead is quite refined as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Clap, clap, clap, clap—*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My throat is dry... I'll go fetch us some drinks.
What would you like to have?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Orange juice for me, then.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much for today.
I deeply appreciate your thoughtful consideration.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to send a gift in return
at a later date.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
Then, I would like to borrow your "time."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: As my predecessor in the Twinkle Series, there is much I wish to learn from you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ――Then, allow me to extend an invitation to a tea party in the near future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing behind them as an attendant and watching it all unfold...
I could only marvel at Rose Kingdom's effortless grace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her splendid manner of escorting is so flawless
that one might mistake her for medieval royalty.
choice_data_list: 映画の世界のようですね

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is it really something worth going that far over...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, her conduct was more than worthy of the entire venue's acclaim.
And that she carries herself so naturally without a trace of conceit—
that spirit of hers is truly magnificent.
choice_data_list: まさしく理想的な王子のごときご対応でした

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Mm... Is that so...?
choice_data_list: 私にお命じになった手配も完璧でしたし

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: No... it is fine, that is quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —I must admit, it is somewhat bashful.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It would look quite striking,
even if used as a movie set.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, this hotel heavily incorporates medieval Gothic architecture.
If time permits, shall we explore beyond this hall?
choice_data_list: あ、いえ、そういう意味では……

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I described it as being 'like a movie,'
I was referring to the interaction between Rose Kingdom
and the others, but...
choice_data_list: （この方は……時折、鈍感でいらっしゃる）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how she didn't quite realize
just how splendid her own conduct was,
I couldn't help but smile fondly.
